packageRules.description: Generated by flux install and marked DO NOT EDIT; the flux manager would otherwise regenerate the whole file
busybox is pinned to no tag, python is a deliberate interpreter pin, and homepage is built and pushed by hand
Routine bumps merge themselves once CI is green and the release is 3 days old; majors are left for review
Patch has to be its own branch or disabling minor below would take the patches down with it
ansible-core is locked for Kubespray compatibility and 2.18.18 is the CVE-2026-11332 floor, so patches only
Held below 5 for the adguard password hashing path
The setup-python interpreter is the same deliberate pin as the python image above, which matches on packageName and so misses this one
CI only plans, so a provider bump that changes real infra at apply time gets read first
